notes.title: BRUTAL KATANA v2.1.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changed slide input buffer to constantly reset if you're holding the slide input while airborne (before it only reset when you pressed the slide input while airborne).
[*] Added a Speedometer Type setting. This lets you choose between a Combined (normal) or Separated speedometer. This setting can be found under Options > Game > Speedometer Type.
[*] Added an in-game Input Overlay. To activate it go to Options > Game > Input Overlay.
[*] Added a Persistent Timer. This lets you track completion time across multiple levels. To activate it go to Options > Game > Persistent Timer. There is also a keybind to quick-reset the Persistent Timer, this keybind is found under Options > Game > Controls > Reset Persistent Timer.
[*] Fixed being stuck in slow-mo if you held the grappling button before starting a wall climb.
[*] Fixed the level timer starting when paused if attack or grappling input was received.
[/list]

notes.title: V2.0.0 OUT NOW!
notes.content:
The v2.0.0 update for BRUTAL KATANA is now publicly available (for [u]free[/u])! There is also a 35% discount for any new players looking to buy the game.

Here's a quick overview of the changes that have been made since the last build:

[list]
[*] Added 24 new levels.
[*] Added 2 new environment themes.
[*] Added zipline mechanic.
[*] Added grappling hook mechanic.
[*] Added jump pads.
[*] General improvements to the game UI.
[*] Added avatars (icons) to leaderboard entries.
[*] Added Steam Rich Presence.
[*] Fixed improper spacing of some UI elements on the level complete menu screen.
[*] Smaller bug fixes.
[/list]

I hope you enjoy the new update and thanks for playing!

notes.title: DEV UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It has been a while since I last updated the game or posted anything related to it. I've spent the last couple of months working on a big new update, namely the v2.0.0 update of the game. The v2.0.0 update will be completely [u]free[/u]!

Below you can find some more information about the update and what exactly I've been working on for the past months.

[h1]NEW CONTENT![/h1]

The v2.0.0 update doubles the amount of content in the game! Here's a quick list of what the update contains:

[list]
[*] 24 new levels
[*] 2 new environments
[*] 3 new mechanics
[*] Small UI improvements
[*] Some minor bug fixes
[/list]

[h1]NEW MECHANICS AND LEVELS![/h1]

And here are some videos and screenshots that show off the new levels, environments and mechanics.

[previewyoutube=NujAIwf2l-k;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041074/ce9413a36facf37d36c549d7b3793c8602408d0d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041074/a28d6540970101c5c837e0dd459e983d25027ffc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041074/28c6f6c5dfb2dc6639592f5dd413096aab8c8e85.png[/img]

[h1]UI IMPROVEMENTS![/h1]

Here are some screenshots that show off the UI improvements. Most improvements are hard to notice but the most notable would be the leaderboards. Leaderboards now have user icons and better formatting so that longer usernames don't get cutoff!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041074/4440584660c7ae348e97fc44f7c71693195911ec.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041074/bcf0cc95bd60f8bc83e5dcd895e0ecc3005d74bd.png[/img]

[h1]THE END[/h1]

That's it for this dev update, hopefully it got you a bit excited for the v2.0.0 update. I can't say for sure when it will release but I expect that it will be out in about 1-2 weeks!

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: BRUTAL KATANA v1.0.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added shader compilation to the startup sequence of the game. This will make the gameplay experience smoother for lower-end hardware and will also make sure that the experience is smoother in the following scenarios: after a graphics driver update, after purposeful/accidental clearing of shader cache, and after updating to newer versions of BRUTAL KATANA. 
[*] Fixed the texture sampling for UI textures, they now look silky smooth again!
[*] Fixed a typo in the ending cutscenes' dialogue.
[/list]
